items.title: CVE-2026-129814
items.description: The SDO Information Get Object Description and Get Entry Description responses copy the object or entry name into the mailbox data area and then write a null terminator byte. The copy loops ran up to the last available byte in the buffer, leaving no room for the terminator. When an object or entry name exactly fills the available space the terminator is written one byte past the end of the mailbox data buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129813
items.description: The CoE complete-access download handler iterated over all subindices of an object and wrote the master-supplied payload into each writable entry. Entries that hold a constant have write-access flags set but carry a NULL data pointer. The handler did not check for this and wrote the master payload through the NULL pointer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129812
items.description: An object dictionary entry that holds a constant has no process data storage and carries a NULL data pointer. sizeOfPDO did not check for this when resolving a mapped entry to its descriptor. A master that maps such an entry to a PDO causes COE_pdoPack or COE_pdoUnpack to dereference the NULL data pointer on every process data exchange after the mapping is activated.

items.title: CVE-2026-129811
items.description: The PDO mapping bit lengths stored in the mapping objects are writable by the master via SDO. sizeOfPDO summed them without checking the total against the size of the rxpdo[] or txpdo[] process data buffers. A master can craft a mapping whose total bit count exceeds those buffers, causing COE_pdoPack and COE_pdoUnpack to write past their ends during each process data cycle after the PREOP to SAFEOP transition.

items.title: CVE-2026-129810
items.description: ESC_eoeprocess and ESC_eoeprocess_tx can be reached before the application calls EOE_config to supply the callback table pointer. When eoe_cfg is NULL the receive handler dereferenced it while processing an incoming EoE frame, and the transmit polling function dereferenced it on each cycle, causing NULL pointer dereferences.

items.title: CVE-2026-129809
items.description: ESC_foeprocess can be reached by an incoming mailbox frame before the application calls FOE_config to supply the file table and flush buffer pointers. When foe_cfg or its fbuffer field is NULL the handler dereferenced those pointers while processing the frame, causing a NULL pointer dereference.

items.title: CVE-2026-129808
items.description: The EoE receive and transmit paths call the handle_recv_buffer and fetch_send_buffer callbacks without first checking whether they are set. Both callbacks are documented as optional; an application that omits either one causes a call through a NULL function pointer when the first EoE frame arrives or when the transmit polling loop runs.

items.title: CVE-2026-129807
items.description: The FoE file table allows entries to omit a write handler by setting write_function to NULL, making the file read-only. FOE_fopen did not check whether write_function was present before accepting a write request; a master sending a WRQ for a read-only file caused a call through a NULL function pointer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129806
items.description: The CoE SDO upload handler enters its normal-response path (used for objects longer than 4 bytes) and passes (objd + nsub)->data directly to the pre-object handler and to the response copy. Entries that hold a constant in the value field have data set to NULL; a master can request such an entry and cause a NULL pointer dereference in the upload path.

items.title: CVE-2026-129805
items.description: An object dictionary entry can carry write-access flags and still have a NULL data pointer, for example when a constant value is held in the value field rather than in addressable storage. The CoE SDO download handler checked write access but not whether storage was present, then wrote the master-supplied payload through the NULL pointer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129804
items.description: FOE_read and FOE_write store the filename length as uint8_t, truncating it modulo 256. When (mbxheader.length - ESC_FOEHSIZE) is a multiple of 256, the length becomes 0. Additionally, a request whose mailbox length equals ESC_FOEHSIZE exactly also produces a length of 0 without any truncation. In both cases FOE_fopen calls strncmp with a length of 0, which always returns equal, so the first registered file whose password is 0 is opened regardless of the filename the master sent.

items.title: CVE-2026-129803
items.description: The CoE entry gate accepts frames with mbxheader.length as low as COE_MINIMUM_LENGTH (8), but a normal SDO Download requires at least COE_HEADERSIZE (10) bytes of CoE payload to carry its header fields. With mbxheader.length of 8 or 9, the segmented-transfer branch misevaluates due to unsigned wrap, leaving the declared SDO size unclamped. copy2mbx then reads that many bytes starting past the end of the actual payload and writes them into the object buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129802
items.description: EOE_set_ip reads each network parameter field (MAC, IP, subnet, gateway, DNS IP, DNS name) from the mailbox payload before checking whether the payload is large enough to contain them. The single bounds check at the end of the function does not prevent the reads from happening. A master can send a Set-IP frame with all flags set and mbxheader.length equal to the minimum, causing all reads to access memory past the end of the payload.

items.title: CVE-2026-129801
items.description: The FoE DATA frame handler computes the payload length from the master-supplied mailbox length field and passes it directly to FOE_fwrite. The length is checked against the remaining file capacity but not against the physical mailbox buffer size. A master can declare a large length while sending a short frame, causing FOE_fwrite to read past the end of the mailbox buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129800
items.description: sizeOfPDO, called during state transitions, uses the subindex-0 count of the SM-assign and PDO-mapping objects as loop bounds without checking those counts against the descriptor array sizes. On builds where those subindex-0 values are writable via SDO, a master can write 0xFF and cause sizeOfPDO to read past the end of the descriptor arrays on the next transition to SAFEOP.

items.title: CVE-2026-129799
items.description: A CoE SDO request for index 0xFFFF matches the object list terminator entry instead of returning not-found. The terminator has a NULL objdesc pointer. Callers dereference it without checking, crashing the slave.

items.title: CVE-2026-129798
items.description: The CoE SDO segmented download handler advances a write pointer by each incoming segment's size but does not track how many bytes have been written in total. A master can keep sending non-last segments until the pointer has walked past the end of the object buffer or the complete-access staging buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129797
items.description: SDO_downloadsegment is called whenever a mailbox frame carries the DOWNLOADSEGREQ command byte, regardless of whether a segmented download is actually in progress. ESCvar.data, which the handler writes through, is NULL until a segmented transfer is started. A master can send a DOWNLOADSEGREQ at any time and write through a NULL or stale pointer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129796
items.description: The CoE SDO download handler for flexible-length objects (VISIBLE_STRING, OCTET_STRING, and similar) does not check that the master-declared transfer size fits within the object before writing. Two distinct writes are affected: the VISIBLE_STRING zero-padding memset and the first-frame copy into the object buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129795
items.description: When the last EoE fragment has the TIME_APPEND flag set, the handler subtracts 4 from rxframeoffset to strip the timestamp. There is no check that rxframeoffset is at least 4. A fragment carrying fewer than 4 bytes of payload that is also marked LAST causes rxframeoffset to wrap to 0xFFFFFFFC, which is then stored as the buffer length and handed to the TCP/IP stack.

items.title: CVE-2026-129794
items.description: The EoE fragment reassembly code uses a frame size from the wire as the bound for memcpy into the application receive buffer, without checking that the declared size fits in the actual buffer. A master can write up to 2016 bytes into a buffer the application may have sized much smaller.

items.description: The Shortcodes Ultimate  WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not escape the error message returned when a remote feed cannot be retrieved before outputting it, which could allow users with the contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against administrators by pointing the feed at a server they control.

items.title: CVE-2026-131976
items.description: The Shortcodes Ultimate  WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not prevent placeholders in a shortcode attribute from being expanded with unescaped nested shortcode output, allowing users with a role as low as contributor to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-131975
items.description: The Shortcodes Ultimate  WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not prevent format specifiers in a shortcode attribute from being interpreted when building navigation menu markup, which could allow users with a role as low as Contributor to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-131971
items.description: The Payment forms, Buy now buttons, and Invoicing System | GetPaid WordPress plugin before 2.8.63 does not check that the visitor is allowed to view an invoice before rendering it through its single-invoice shortcode, and its payment-form embed page lets unauthenticated users render that shortcode for any invoice ID, disclosing customers' names, billing addresses, phone numbers, line items and payment status.

items.title: CVE-2026-130894
items.description: The Newsletter  WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not protect its unsubscription actions against Cross-Site Request Forgery for subscribers it identifies from its own tracking cookie, allowing attackers to unsubscribe a subscriber from the site's newsletter by making them visit a malicious page.

items.title: CVE-2026-130892
items.description: The Newsletter  WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not properly validate the destination of the redirect performed when a subscriber changes their list membership from a newsletter link, checking only that it begins with the site's URL, allowing unauthenticated attackers to redirect users to external sites whose address starts with the site's URL.

items.title: CVE-2026-130891
items.description: The Newsletter  WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not check that a visitor is really the subscriber before showing them newsletters marked as private, and accepts a weaker subscriber identifier that anyone can obtain by submitting a known subscriber's email address to the public subscription form, allowing unauthenticated attackers who know a subscriber's email address to read every private newsletter sent to that subscriber.

items.title: CVE-2026-127002
items.description: The RSVP and Event Management WordPress plugin before 2.7.19 does not escape a submitted value before outputting it back in its RSVP form when the form is re-displayed after a failed submission, leading to a Reflected Cross-Site Scripting which could be used against high-privilege users such as admins.

items.title: CVE-2026-126039
items.description: The Hide My WP Ghost  WordPress plugin before 7.0.19 does not limit one of its HTML output rewriting patterns to the markup it targets, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject HTML attributes through a comment author name that execute as Stored XSS for any visitor, including logged-in administrators, on pages that list recent comments.

items.title: CVE-2026-125932
items.description: The Coupon Creator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'metavalue (with metakeyinput=cctor_expiration)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit is possible because the cctor_coupon post type advertises 'custom-fields' support, enabling WordPress core's Custom Fields metabox for Contributors, and the unregistered cctor_expiration meta key causes sanitize_meta() to be a no-op, allowing raw HTML to be stored verbatim in the database via a single AJAX request.

items.title: CVE-2026-123663
items.description: The ProfilePress  WordPress plugin before 4.18.1 takes the role for an account registered through a combined login and registration form from the separate registration form that shares its numeric ID, allowing unauthenticated users to register with the elevated role, such as Editor, assigned by an unpublished registration form.

items.title: CVE-2026-121155
items.description: The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 do not preserve the escaping of JSON-formatted database values when they rewrite the database during a restore to a new address or server, which could allow unauthenticated attackers to plant harmless-looking escaped markup, for example in a comment author name, that becomes Stored Cross-Site Scripting once an administrator performs such a restore.

items.title: CVE-2026-121154
items.description:
The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 do not keep serialized string lengths consistent when their database search and replace processes certain serialized values, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to plant data that becomes an attacker-chosen PHP object after an administrator runs a URL-lengthening search and replace or a migration restore.

When the replacement changes the length of the text, the declared string lengths inside the stored value no longer match and the corrupted value is written back, so when WordPress later reads it the trailing bytes are parsed as further serialized structure, including an object of a class the attacker named. items.title: CVE-2026-121153
items.description:
The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 do not keep a serialized value inert when their database search and replace reaches its recursion limit, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to plant data in their own user meta that is rewritten into a live PHP object when an administrator later runs a search and replace or a migration restore, and is then instantiated by WordPress on a later read.

This is distinct from CVE-2024-10957, whose fix restricted the unserialize call but left this path in place. items.title: CVE-2026-121152
items.description: The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 do not safely process the output of the external database dump tool when backing up large tables, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to store profile data that turns into SQL executed when an administrator later restores the backup, for example to grant themselves the administrator role.

items.title: CVE-2026-121151
items.description:
The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 do not preserve long database values byte-for-byte when restoring a database backup, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to plant a serialized value that becomes a PHP Object Injection once an administrator backs up and restores the database.

No gadget chain is known in the UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 or WordPress core, so the demonstrated effect is instantiation of an attacker-chosen class in the attacker's own requests. Exploitation requires the planted data to line up exactly with how the backup is read back, which depends on details of the attacker's row and the database dump format.

items.title: CVE-2026-121150
items.description:
The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 do not correctly handle comment-like content found in the middle of a long SQL statement when restoring a database backup, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber who have stored crafted content in their own profile to have SQL executed when an administrator later restores a backup, and so escalate their account to administrator.

This is a different code path from the backup restore issue fixed in 1.26.10, and it does not depend on the database server's maximum packet size.

items.title: CVE-2026-120539
items.description: The Restrictions for BuddyPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.4 This is due to the plugin splicing the attacker-controlled request URI into a PHP expression inside a double-quoted string and evaluating it with eval(). Because PHP interpolates double-quoted strings, a payload of the form {${...}} in the URL path is executed during interpolation, so no quote breakout is required and WordPress' slashing does not mitigate it. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on the server with a single GET request. The affected conditions ship enabled by default and are evaluated before any logged-in check, so no plugin configuration is needed; the site must have BuddyPress and Paid Memberships Pro active alongside this plugin.

items.title: CVE-2026-119607
items.description: The Salon Booking System – Appointment Booking for Salons, Barbershops & Spas plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 10.31.16. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to overwrite arbitrary users' user meta fields, including the _sln_phone and _sln_sms_prefix meta of administrator accounts, and create bookings attributed to arbitrary users. This is exploitable on default installations because reCAPTCHA is disabled by default, causing the booking endpoint's permission check to return true for any authenticated user without a meaningful authorization gate.

items.title: CVE-2026-119184
items.description: The Mapster WP Maps — Mapbox, MapLibre & Google Maps for WordPress plugin before 2.0.7 does not perform any authorization check when saving edits made through its bundled photo-gallery library, allowing any authenticated user with at least Contributor-level access to overwrite the title and content of, and write arbitrary metadata onto, any post, page or media attachment on the site regardless of ownership.

items.title: CVE-2026-115226
items.description: The GiveWP  WordPress plugin before 4.19.2.1 does not properly restrict access to sensitive donor information in one of its REST API endpoints, allowing any authenticated user who owns a donor record, such as a subscriber who has donated once, to retrieve the email address, phone number, name, postal address and company of all donors.

items.title: CVE-2026-114436
items.description: The Video Conferencing with Zoom WordPress plugin before 4.7.0 does not check that a requested Zoom meeting's recordings were published on the site before fetching them with the site's connected Zoom account, allowing unauthenticated users who know a meeting ID to retrieve that meeting's cloud recording details, including its topic, share link, passcode when returned by Zoom, and direct play and download links.

items.title: CVE-2026-114435
items.description: The Video Conferencing with Zoom WordPress plugin before 4.7.0 does not check authorization, or whether a meeting is restricted to logged-in users, password-protected or unpublished, before returning a meeting's join links, allowing unauthenticated users to obtain the passcode-embedded join links of any meeting, including meetings the site restricts.

items.title: CVE-2026-114434
items.description: The Video Conferencing with Zoom WordPress plugin before 4.7.0 does not check that the requester is authorized to join a meeting before issuing a Zoom Meeting SDK signature for it, allowing unauthenticated users to obtain a valid signed join credential for an arbitrary meeting.

items.title: CVE-2026-111975
items.description: The GiveWP  WordPress plugin before 4.19.2.1 does not exclude donors who chose to give anonymously from one of its public REST API listings, allowing unauthenticated users to retrieve those donors' names.

items.title: CVE-2026-111067
items.description:
The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.10, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.10.26 does not guard all execution paths of its database restore process against second-order SQL injection, allowing a Subscriber-level user who has stored crafted content in their own account to escalate to administrator when an administrator later restores a backup.
This is due to an incomplete fix of CVE-2026-108761 in 1.26.9: the fix guards only one of the restore routine's execution paths, and a second path remains exploitable.

items.title: CVE-2026-133958
items.description: A flaw was found in Quay. Insufficient validation of repository notification webhook URLs allows an authenticated administrator to trigger Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF). By specifying an internal URL or a redirect to an internal destination, an attacker can force the Quay worker to issue unauthorized HTTP requests to internal network locations and cloud metadata services.

items.title: CVE-2026-19793
items.description: The WP Import Export Lite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Limited Code Injection in all versions up to, and including, 3.9.32 via the 'comment' parameter. This is due to a two-stage shortcode check that evaluates the raw mapping placeholder before data substitution, causing the neutralizer to be skipped when attacker-controlled comment content containing a malicious [wpie_function] shortcode is substituted at runtime. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary PHP callables on the server. Exploitation requires an Administrator to perform the standard Export With Settings For Import followed by a New Import migration workflow, which is a routine operational task; the attacker themselves requires no account or authentication, needing only the ability to submit a pending comment on any comments-open post.

items.title: CVE-2026-131651
items.description: The rtMedia for WordPress, BuddyPress and bbPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'media_title' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.7.18 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The vulnerability is only triggerable via the Backbone.js-rendered "Load More" pagination path; the server-side PHP gallery rendering correctly escapes media_title with esc_attr() and is not affected.

items.title: CVE-2026-19030
items.description:
Observable Discrepancy vulnerability in Drupal CAPTCHA for Drupal 7 allows unauthenticated attackers to test login credentials despite CAPTCHA protection.

When CAPTCHA is enabled on Drupal login forms, normal form validation can still run after a missing or incorrect CAPTCHA response. This may expose credential validation feedback and allow an attacker to distinguish invalid credentials from valid credentials paired with a failed CAPTCHA.



This issue affects CAPTCHA for Drupal 7: from 7.x-1.0 through 7.x-1.7.

items.title: CVE-2026-16132
items.description:
A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Icon API: Menu submodule of the Drupal 7 Icon API module. When a menu item is configured with the Title Wrapper option enabled, the value of the Title Wrapper Class field is output directly into an HTML attribute without sanitization or escaping. A user with the "administer menu icons" permission can inject a payload such as `title" onmouseover="alert(document.cookie)` that is rendered verbatim on every page displaying the affected menu item, executing arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of any user who interacts with the menu link. This can lead to session theft, account hijacking, and further attacks against site users.

This issue affects Icon API 7.1.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-134172
items.description: audio-separator before 0.47.2 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by supplying malicious Demucs .th model files loaded via torch.load with weights_only=False. Local users writing to the shared /tmp/audio-separator-models/ default directory, or attackers controlling unverified model download sources, can execute code when victims run Demucs separation.

items.title: CVE-2026-134171
items.description: Cesanta Mongoose 7.21 before 7.24 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in rx_ip6() checksum validation that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to read past received packets by sending IPv6 extension headers. Attackers can send a single IPv6 TCP or ICMPv6 packet with extension headers, causing tcp6csum_ok() and icmp6csum_ok() to use the full payload length and read adjacent receive-buffer memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134170
items.description: Cesanta Mongoose 7.22 before 7.24 with the built-in TLS stack contains an out-of-bounds read in mg_timegm() that allows remote attackers to crash the process via crafted X.509 certificate validity months. Attackers can present a certificate with month '00' or out-of-range values during the handshake, before signature verification, causing an unchecked dm array index and denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134169
items.description: Qwik City before 1.20.3 (@builder.io/qwik-city) and @qwik.dev/router before 2.0.0-rc.4 contain an improperly controlled object modification vulnerability in formToObj that allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite built-in function properties. Attackers can send a form POST with nested field names traversing inherited members of string values, breaking Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call process-wide until server restart.

items.title: CVE-2026-134168
items.description: devpi-server before 6.21.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write files outside the +files storage root by naming a user and index '..'. Attackers can self-register a '..' user, create a '..' index, and upload release files with attacker-chosen filenames and contents into a parent of the server directory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134167
items.description: devpi-web before 5.2.0 contains an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in the +doc documentation route because docs_file_exists and docs_file_path in doczip.py never confine relpath to the documentation directory. Attackers can request a relpath with a leading // or percent-encoded .. segments to read server files, including the keyfs sqlite database holding password hashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-134166
items.description: probe-image-size before 7.5.0 contains an unbounded memory buffering vulnerability in parseExif in lib/parse_stream/webp.js that allows remote attackers to exhaust memory via an attacker-declared EXIF chunk length. Attackers can supply a WebP stream or URL to probe(url) or probe(stream) declaring a huge EXIF length after VP8X, causing unbounded buffering and process memory exhaustion.

items.title: CVE-2026-134165
items.description: probe-image-size before 7.5.0 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in lib/parse_stream/avif.js that allows remote attackers to exhaust memory via attacker-declared ftyp or meta box sizes. Attackers can supply an AVIF stream or URL to probe(url) or probe(stream) declaring a huge box length, forcing the parser to buffer all received bytes and causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134164
items.description: probe-image-size before 7.5.0 contains an algorithmic-complexity denial of service vulnerability in lib/exif_utils.js that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying self-referencing EXIF IFDs. Attackers can submit a crafted 9.6 KB JPEG with repeated ExifIFD and InteropIFD pointers to block the Node.js event loop for about 23 seconds.

items.title: CVE-2026-134163
items.description: probe-image-size 7.4.0 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in lib/common/svg_header.js that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to block the event loop via crafted SVG doctypes. Attackers can supply SVGs with an unclosed internal subset followed by many ']' characters to trigger quadratic backtracking in probe.sync, probe(stream) or probe(url), causing repeated event loop stalls.

items.description: OceanWP WordPress Theme before 4.2.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the oceanwp_edd_terms_list() function in inc/edd/edd-helpers.php, which allows authenticated users with EDD download category creation permissions to inject malicious JavaScript by crafting a category name that breaks out of an unescaped HTML title attribute. items.title: CVE-2026-54046
items.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, unauthenticated POST /api/user/verify requests in api/server/routes/user.js call api/server/services/AuthService.js verifyEmail and return distinct responses for unknown, verified, and unverified email addresses and the route lacks request throttling. A remote attacker can submit candidate addresses with invalid tokens to enumerate registered accounts and verification state, supporting targeted phishing or credential attacks. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.

items.title: CVE-2026-54045
items.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, POST /api/auth/requestPasswordReset calls deleteTokens by user ID before creating a reset token, while password-reset and email-verification records in packages/data-schemas/src/methods/token.ts have no populated flow type. When password reset is enabled and email verification is enforced, an unauthenticated attacker who knows a target email can repeatedly delete pending verification tokens and prevent account verification until the unverified account expires. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.

items.title: CVE-2026-54044
items.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, POST /api/agents/actions/:agent_id in api/server/routes/agents/actions.js loads an existing action with owner credentials and merges editor-controlled metadata.domain and metadata.raw_spec while preserving metadata.api_key and related OAuth client secrets. A collaborator with EDIT permission can repoint an action to an attacker-controlled host, and a later tool invocation decrypts and sends the retained owner credential to that destination. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.

items.title: CVE-2026-54043
items.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, packages/data-schemas/src/methods/file.ts updateFileUsage accepts chat attachment files[].file_id values without restricting the lookup to the authenticated owner. An authenticated attacker who obtains another user's file identifier, including through GET /api/share/{shareId} for a shared conversation, can attach that file to a chat, causing extracted document text to enter the model context. The same operation can remove expiration metadata from the victim file. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.

items.title: CVE-2026-54042
items.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, POST /api/auth/2fa/verify-temp in api/server/routes/auth.js calls verify2FAWithTempToken and accepts repeated TOTP or backup-code guesses without a dedicated attempt limiter. An attacker must first possess valid primary credentials and a valid five-minute temp token, but can then make repeated second-factor attempts and obtain a full session if a valid code is guessed. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.

items.title: CVE-2026-54041
items.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.6, the POST /api/auth/login local-login validation path in api/strategies/localStrategy.js logs req.body, including the submitted plaintext password, during a Zod validation failure. The standard browser form validation makes this path less likely through the normal interface, but a direct invalid login request can reach it, and the logging formatter does not redact the password stored in metadata. A principal with access to application stdout, error logs, or journal output can recover the submitted credential. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.6.

items.title: CVE-2026-54039
items.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. From 0.7.0 until 0.8.6, when local registration is enabled and at least one social provider is configured, POST /api/auth/register passes an unparsed request object into api/server/services/AuthService.js, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to persist a forged provider value for a known victim email. items.title: CVE-2026-54032
items.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.6, client/src/components/Chat/Input/MCPConfigDialog.tsx renders the remote MCP details.description value through dangerouslySetInnerHTML without sanitization, allowing a malicious MCP server to execute script when a user opens the configuration dialog. The secondary client/src/components/Banners/Banner.tsx sink similarly renders administrator-controlled banner.message HTML without sanitization for all users. Script execution occurs in the LibreChat browser origin and can expose browser-context data or alter displayed content. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.6.

items.title: CVE-2026-54031
items.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.8, packages/api/src/mcp/oauth/handler.ts createOAuthFetch validates only the initial destination for MCP OAuth discovery, registration, token, refresh, and revocation requests, then uses redirect-following fetch behavior without validating each redirect target. An attacker who can initiate MCP OAuth against a controlled endpoint can redirect server requests to internal or private addresses, reaching services that the initial SSRF checks should block. The separate MCP transport path already validates redirects and is not affected. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.8.

items.title: CVE-2026-54023
items.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. From 0.8.5 until 0.8.6, GET /api/user in api/server/controllers/UserController.js getUserController serializes federatedTokens and tokenset to the authenticated browser because an earlier response-sanitization fix was not applied to this endpoint. Browser-context script can obtain OAuth access, ID, and refresh credentials that were intended to remain server-side. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.6.

items.title: CVE-2026-19779
items.description:
G DATA Total Security Backup Service Uncontrolled Search Path Element Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of G DATA Total Security. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the Backup Service. The service restores archives from an unsecured location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-28666.

items.title: CVE-2026-19777
items.description:

This vulnerability allows local attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of G DATA Total Security. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the G DATA ANTIVIRUS Proxy Service. By creating a symbolic link, an attacker can abuse the service to create a file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a persistent denial-of-service condition on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-28662.

items.title: CVE-2026-134052
items.description:
Open Robotics RViz fillIndexBuffer Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Open Robotics RViz. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of mesh resources in PointCloud and Marker displays. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-32652.

items.title: CVE-2026-134051
items.description:
Open Robotics RViz XYZPCTransformer PointField Out-Of-Bounds Read Denial-of-Service Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Open Robotics RViz. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the XYZPCTransformer handling of PointCloud2 messages. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-32642.
